reason: I forget my pills at home all the time and I travel a lot, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag fits how I live. The named lab and the batch report make me trust it more than the random magnesium on TikTok, and $24.99 for one box is low risk.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is subtle, and I might finish 30 sachets and not notice anything.
would_change_my_mind: If the first box were not the launch price or if the lab report did not match the batch number on my box, I would pass.
